# Thunder Studio

> Professional music rehearsal rooms and recording studio in Bangkok, Thailand.

Thunder Studio is a music rehearsal and recording facility located in Bang Khen, Bangkok. Part of Thunder Venture Group. Open daily 10:00-22:00.

## Rooms

### Large Rehearsal Room
- Capacity: 6-10 people
- Equipment: Marshall amps, full drum kit, PA system, mics and stands
- Ideal for full bands and pre-gig rehearsals

### Small Rehearsal Room
- Capacity: 2-4 people
- Equipment: Guitar amp, PA system, mics and stands
- Ideal for solo practice, duos, or small groups
- Fully soundproofed

### Control Room
- Capacity: 2-3 people
- Equipment: Mixing console, rack gear, studio monitors, DAW workstation
- For recording, mixing, or mastering

## Features
- Pro-grade sound equipment (Marshall amps, full drum kits, premium PA systems)
- Acoustic treatment and soundproofed walls
- Recording studio with mixing console
- Lounge area and attic space
